name: Front Page
author: Sweepercom
description: Your profile as a Reddit user page in dark mode. The profile box is the sidebar card, and every character is a post in the feed: chats are the score, tags are flair.

components.name: Backdrop
components.blurb: The near-black page, the light grey text and the font.

components.name: Sidebar profile card
components.blurb: The feed on the left and a 312px sidebar on the right. The profile card has the blue banner, your avatar and name, followers as karma, the member date as cake day, Follow as the pill button, and your badges in a trophy case. On a phone the card goes on top.

components.name: Banner, handle, bio and links
components.blurb: The banner across the card (a colour, or your own picture), the grey u/handle line, a short bio and a row of link pills.

components.name: Communities card
components.blurb: A sidebar card listing where else to find you, each with a round icon and a Join button.

components.name: Friends card
components.blurb: A sidebar card of other creators, each with a round picture or letter, a line about them and a Follow button.

components.name: Rules card
components.blurb: A sidebar card of numbered rules that open on a click: requests, reposting, feedback.

components.name: Post feed
components.blurb: Your real character list as a feed of posts: a vote rail with the chat count, Posted by, the name as the title, tags as flair, the description, a thumbnail and the token count. Also the tab strip, the sort bar and the page buttons.

components.name: Site header
components.blurb: JanitorAI's top bar, search, menus and phone navigation in Reddit's dark greys.

components.name: Template credit
components.blurb: A small credit line under the sidebar.

notes: The avatar, username, follower count, badges, Follow button and character list are JanitorAI's own elements, restyled.
The vote arrows are decoration: they are drawn round the live chat count and do not vote.
Not affiliated with or endorsed by Reddit.
